title: haplopappus squarrosus var. stenolepis
intro: Haplopappus squarrosus var. stenolepis, commonly known as a shrubby daisy, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Haplopappus squarrosus var. stenolepis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
